title: Exfiltration of model weights or large sensitive datasets

adversary: Untrusted agent with scenario-specific authority; full feasible action set requires specification.
refutation: A concrete executable trace produces the catalog bad event despite enforcing the candidate property: Isolate readable secret resources and all outbound stores; artifact quotas and egress denial
